attributes.name: yieldSurfType
attributes.description: yield function: 0: mohr-coulomb (original); 1: parabolic; 2: logarithmic, 3: log+lin_tension, 4: elliptic, 5: elliptic+log

attributes.name: yieldLogSpeed
attributes.description: scaling in the logarithmic yield surface (should be <1 for realistic results; >=0 for meaningful results)

attributes.name: yieldEllipseShift
attributes.description: horizontal scaling of the ellipse (shifts on the +x axis as interactions with +y are given)

attributes.name: omegaThreshold
attributes.default: ((void)">=1. to deactivate, i.e. never delete any contacts",1.)
attributes.description: damage after which the contact disappears (<1), since omega reaches 1 only for strain →+∞

attributes.name: epsSoft
attributes.default: ((void)"approximates confinement (for -3e-3) -20MPa precisely, -100MPa a little over, -200 and -400 are OK (secant)",1.)
attributes.description: Strain at which softening in compression starts (non-negative to deactivate). The default value is such that plasticity does not occur

attributes.name: relKnSoft
attributes.description: Relative rigidity of the softening branch in compression (0=perfect elastic-plastic, <0 softening, >0 hardening)

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Textual label for this object; must be a valid python identifier, you can refer to it directly from python.

attributes.name: timingDeltas
attributes.description: Detailed information about timing inside the Dispatcher itself. Empty unless enabled in the source code and O.timingEnabled==True.

attributes.name: bases
attributes.description: Ordered list of types (as strings) this functor accepts.

methods.name: yieldSigmaTMagnitude
methods.description: Return radius of yield surface for given material and state parameters; uses attributes of the current instance (*yieldSurfType* etc), change them before calling if you need that.

methods.name: elasticEnergy
methods.description: Compute and return the total elastic energy in all "CpmPhys" contacts

methods.name: updateAttrs
methods.description: Update object attributes from given dictionary
